scripts.build:browser:wasm: sh -ec 'toolchain="$(rustup show active-toolchain | cut -d " " -f1)"; rustc="$(rustup which rustc --toolchain "$toolchain")"; cargo="$(rustup which cargo --toolchain "$toolchain")"; RUSTC="$rustc" "$cargo" build --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile browser-release --features browser-wasm'
scripts.build:browser:profiles: sh -ec 'toolchain="$(rustup show active-toolchain | cut -d " " -f1)"; rustc="$(rustup which rustc --toolchain "$toolchain")"; cargo="$(rustup which cargo --toolchain "$toolchain")"; RUSTC="$rustc" "$cargo" build --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile browser-release --features browser-wasm; rm -rf packages/browser/src/wasm; wasm-bindgen --target web --out-name hara_wasm --out-dir packages/browser/src/wasm ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/browser-release/hara_native.wasm; HARA_BROWSER_VARIANT=native-vm npm run build:browser; cp packages/browser/src/hara.d.ts packages/browser/dist/native-vm/hara.d.ts; RUSTC="$rustc" "$cargo" build --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile browser-release --features browser-wasm,whole-wasm; rm -rf packages/browser/src/wasm; wasm-bindgen --target web --out-name hara_wasm --out-dir packages/browser/src/wasm ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/browser-release/hara_native.wasm; HARA_BROWSER_VARIANT=native-full npm run build:browser; cp packages/browser/src/hara.d.ts packages/browser/dist/native-full/hara.d.ts'
